usedFor: humanitix holds events, orders and attendees, and Freshsales Classic receives a deal through “Create Deal” or “Update Deal”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order” in humanitix, then “Create Deal” in Freshsales Classic
bestTemplate.why: An order is a sale, and the deal links to an account, creating the contact if missing.

watchOut: “New Attendes” runs for every attendee on an order, so “Create Deal” can run more than once per order.
